Button component

Reviewed: 2026-05-02

Usage guidelines

Use the primary button for the main decision on a page. Choose secondary or tertiary variants when the action is less important.

Anatomy

The component includes label, icon slot, loading state, size, density, and disabled state.

Code examples

Install the code package before using examples.

npm install @acme/design-system
import { Button } from "@acme/design-system";
<Button variant="primary">Save</Button>

Do's and Don'ts

Do use one primary button per decision area because it protects hierarchy. Don't use disabled buttons without explaining the blocked state. Avoid destructive labels without confirmation.

Accessibility notes

Use aria-label only when the visible label is absent. The button must support keyboard activation, visible focus, and screen reader names.

Figma library

Figma library embed for the production component set.
